datasets.name: card_kpi
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date,
         date_format(c.report_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS cm,
         date_format(add_months(c.report_date, -1), 'yyyy-MM') AS lm,
         concat(CAST(year(c.report_date) - 1 AS STRING), '-12') AS ye,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, m AS (
  SELECT f.year_month, max(f.snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.new_members) END AS new_m, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.closed_members) END AS closed_m,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.using_members) END AS usg, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.spend_amt) END AS spend,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.ytd_complete) THEN sum(f.new_members_ytd) END AS new_ytd,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.ytd_complete) THEN sum(f.spend_amt_ytd) END AS spend_ytd,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.purchase_amt) END AS purchase, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.installment_amt) END AS installment,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.cash_advance_amt) END AS cash, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.flexi_amt) END AS flexi,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.domestic_amt) END AS domestic, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.xborder_amt) END AS xborder,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.pos_amt) END AS pos, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.online_amt) END AS online,
         sum(f.eop_members) AS eop, sum(f.balance) AS bal, sum(f.revolving_balance) AS rev,
         sum(f.dpd_1p_balance) AS dpd1, sum(f.dpd_10p_balance) AS dpd10,
         sum(f.dpd_30p_balance) AS dpd30, sum(f.npl_90p_balance) AS npl
  FROM gold_serving.card_mart_kpi_monthly f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
  WHERE (:customer_type = 'all' OR f.cust_type = CASE :customer_type WHEN 'consumer' THEN 'CN' ELSE 'TC' END)
  GROUP BY f.year_month),
six AS (SELECT m.* FROM m CROSS JOIN cur
        WHERE m.year_month > date_format(add_months(cur.d, -6), 'yyyy-MM'))
SELECT cur.d AS report_date, m.new_m AS new_acquisition, m.eop AS customer_base,
       m.usg AS using_customer, m.spend / cur.usd / 1000 AS sales_volume_k_usd, m.bal / cur.usd / 1000 AS balance_k_usd,
       m.dpd1 / nullif(m.bal, 0) * 100 AS dpd_1p, m.dpd10 / nullif(m.bal, 0) * 100 AS dpd_10p,
       m.dpd30 / nullif(m.bal, 0) * 100 AS dpd_30p, m.npl / nullif(m.bal, 0) * 100 AS npl
FROM cur LEFT JOIN m ON m.year_month = cur.cm

datasets.name: card_kpi_compare
datasets.displayName: Overview KPI vs last month / year-end / target
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date,
         date_format(c.report_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS cm,
         date_format(add_months(c.report_date, -1), 'yyyy-MM') AS lm,
         concat(CAST(year(c.report_date) - 1 AS STRING), '-12') AS ye,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, m AS (
  SELECT f.year_month, max(f.snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.new_members) END AS new_m, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.closed_members) END AS closed_m,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.using_members) END AS usg, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.spend_amt) END AS spend,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.ytd_complete) THEN sum(f.new_members_ytd) END AS new_ytd,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.ytd_complete) THEN sum(f.spend_amt_ytd) END AS spend_ytd,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.purchase_amt) END AS purchase, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.installment_amt) END AS installment,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.cash_advance_amt) END AS cash, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.flexi_amt) END AS flexi,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.domestic_amt) END AS domestic, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.xborder_amt) END AS xborder,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.pos_amt) END AS pos, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.online_amt) END AS online,
         sum(f.eop_members) AS eop, sum(f.balance) AS bal, sum(f.revolving_balance) AS rev,
         sum(f.dpd_1p_balance) AS dpd1, sum(f.dpd_10p_balance) AS dpd10,
         sum(f.dpd_30p_balance) AS dpd30, sum(f.npl_90p_balance) AS npl
  FROM gold_serving.card_mart_kpi_monthly f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
  WHERE (:customer_type = 'all' OR f.cust_type = CASE :customer_type WHEN 'consumer' THEN 'CN' ELSE 'TC' END)
  GROUP BY f.year_month),
six AS (SELECT m.* FROM m CROSS JOIN cur
        WHERE m.year_month > date_format(add_months(cur.d, -6), 'yyyy-MM'))
, t AS (SELECT substr(f.metric_code, 1, length(f.metric_code) - 3) AS code, f.period_type,
               f.target_value
        FROM silver.ref_targets f CROSS JOIN cur
        WHERE left(f.metric_code, 5) = 'CARD_'
          AND (:customer_type = 'all' OR right(f.metric_code, 2) = CASE :customer_type WHEN 'consumer' THEN 'CN' ELSE 'TC' END)
          AND ((f.period_type = 'MONTH' AND f.period = cur.cm)
               OR (f.period_type = 'YEAR' AND f.period = CAST(year(cur.d) AS STRING)))),
tg AS (SELECT
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_NEW_ACQ' AND t.period_type = 'MONTH' THEN t.target_value END) AS new_acquisition_tm,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_NEW_ACQ' AND t.period_type = 'YEAR' THEN t.target_value END) AS new_acquisition_ty,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_CUSTOMER_BASE' AND t.period_type = 'MONTH' THEN t.target_value END) AS customer_base_tm,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_CUSTOMER_BASE' AND t.period_type = 'YEAR' THEN t.target_value END) AS customer_base_ty,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_USING' AND t.period_type = 'MONTH' THEN t.target_value END) AS using_customer_tm,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_USING' AND t.period_type = 'YEAR' THEN t.target_value END) AS using_customer_ty,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_SALES_VOLUME' AND t.period_type = 'MONTH' THEN t.target_value END) AS sales_volume_tm,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_SALES_VOLUME' AND t.period_type = 'YEAR' THEN t.target_value END) AS sales_volume_ty,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_BALANCE' AND t.period_type = 'MONTH' THEN t.target_value END) AS balance_tm,
  sum(CASE WHEN t.code = 'CARD_BALANCE' AND t.period_type = 'YEAR' THEN t.target_value END) AS balance_ty
  FROM t),
c AS (SELECT * FROM m CROSS JOIN cur WHERE m.year_month = cur.cm),
p AS (SELECT m.*, 1 AS line FROM m CROSS JOIN cur WHERE m.year_month = cur.lm
      UNION ALL SELECT m.*, 2 FROM m CROSS JOIN cur WHERE m.year_month = cur.ye)
SELECT l.line, concat(CASE l.line WHEN 1 THEN 'vs Last Month (' ELSE 'vs Last Year-end (' END,
                      l.ym, ')') AS compare,
       round((c.new_m - p.new_m) / nullif(p.new_m, 0) * 100, 1) AS new_acquisition,
       round((c.eop - p.eop) / nullif(p.eop, 0) * 100, 1) AS customer_base,
       round((c.usg - p.usg) / nullif(p.usg, 0) * 100, 1) AS using_customer,
       round((c.spend - p.spend) / nullif(p.spend, 0) * 100, 1) AS sales_volume,
       round((c.bal - p.bal) / nullif(p.bal, 0) * 100, 1) AS balance
FROM (SELECT 1 AS line, lm AS ym FROM cur UNION ALL SELECT 2, ye FROM cur) l
CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN c ON true LEFT JOIN p ON p.line = l.line
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, '% of Month Target',
       round(c.new_m / nullif(tg.new_acquisition_tm, 0) * 100, 1),
       round(c.eop / nullif(tg.customer_base_tm, 0) * 100, 1),
       round(c.usg / nullif(tg.using_customer_tm, 0) * 100, 1),
       round(c.spend / nullif(tg.sales_volume_tm, 0) * 100, 1),
       round(c.bal / nullif(tg.balance_tm, 0) * 100, 1)
FROM tg LEFT JOIN c ON true
UNION ALL
-- năm: luỹ kế (flow) YTD / chỉ tiêu năm; tồn: hiện tại / chỉ tiêu cuối năm; using: không có
SELECT 4, '% of Year Target',
       round(c.new_ytd / nullif(tg.new_acquisition_ty, 0) * 100, 1),
       round(c.eop / nullif(tg.customer_base_ty, 0) * 100, 1), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
       round(c.spend_ytd / nullif(tg.sales_volume_ty, 0) * 100, 1),
       round(c.bal / nullif(tg.balance_ty, 0) * 100, 1)
FROM tg LEFT JOIN c ON true
ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: card_new_acq
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date,
         date_format(c.report_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS cm,
         date_format(add_months(c.report_date, -1), 'yyyy-MM') AS lm,
         concat(CAST(year(c.report_date) - 1 AS STRING), '-12') AS ye,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
SELECT f.year_month AS month,
       CASE f.acquisition_channel WHEN 'SMART_CREDIT' THEN 'Smart Credit' ELSE 'Branches' END
           AS channel,
       CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.new_members) END AS cards
FROM gold_serving.card_mart_kpi_monthly f JOIN cur ON f.as_of_date = cur.d
WHERE (:customer_type = 'all' OR f.cust_type = CASE :customer_type WHEN 'consumer' THEN 'CN' ELSE 'TC' END) AND f.year_month > date_format(add_months(cur.d, -6), 'yyyy-MM')
GROUP BY 1, 2

         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.cash_advance_amt) END AS cash, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.flexi_amt) END AS flexi,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.domestic_amt) END AS domestic, CASE WHEN bool_and(f.flow_complete) THEN sum(f.xborder_amt) END AS xborder,

datasets.name: card_risk_compare
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT c.report_date AS d, c.previous_date, c.previous_month_date,
         date_format(c.report_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS cm,
         date_format(add_months(c.report_date, -1), 'yyyy-MM') AS lm,
         concat(CAST(year(c.report_date) - 1 AS STRING), '-12') AS ye,
         (SELECT max_by(x.rate_to_vnd, x.rate_date) FROM silver.ref_fx_rates x
          WHERE x.currencycd = 'USD' AND x.rate_date <= c.report_date) AS usd
  FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar c
  WHERE c.report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM gold_serving.card_report_calendar WHERE report_date <= :report_date))
, rt AS (SELECT f.as_of_date, sum(f.dpd_1p_balance) / nullif(sum(f.balance), 0) * 100 AS r1,
                sum(f.dpd_10p_balance) / nullif(sum(f.balance), 0) * 100 AS r10,
                sum(f.dpd_30p_balance) / nullif(sum(f.balance), 0) * 100 AS r30,
                sum(f.npl_90p_balance) / nullif(sum(f.balance), 0) * 100 AS rn
         FROM gold_serving.card_mart_kpi_daily f
         WHERE f.as_of_date IN (SELECT d FROM cur UNION ALL SELECT previous_date FROM cur
                                UNION ALL SELECT previous_month_date FROM cur) AND (:customer_type = 'all' OR f.cust_type = CASE :customer_type WHEN 'consumer' THEN 'CN' ELSE 'TC' END)
         GROUP BY f.as_of_date),
l AS (SELECT 1 AS line, 'vs Last Day' AS cmp, previous_date AS dd FROM cur
      UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'vs Last Month', previous_month_date FROM cur)
SELECT l.line, concat(l.cmp, ' (', coalesce(date_format(l.dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'N/A'), ') pp')
           AS compare,
       round(c.r1 - p.r1, 2) AS dpd_1p, round(c.r10 - p.r10, 2) AS dpd_10p,
       round(c.r30 - p.r30, 2) AS dpd_30p, round(c.rn - p.rn, 2) AS npl
FROM l CROSS JOIN cur LEFT JOIN rt c ON c.as_of_date = cur.d LEFT JOIN rt p ON p.as_of_date = l.dd
ORDER BY l.line
